sn47.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati Sālāyam brāhmaṇagāme || || 2.
sn47.4:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi || la [pe] || etad avoca || || 3.
sn47.4:2.1: Ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ || te ve bhikkhave bhikkhū catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanāya samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā ||
sn47.4:2.3: Etha tumhe āvuso kāye kāyānupassino viharatha || ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā kāyassa yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāya || ||
sn47.4:2.4: Vedanāsu vedanānupassino viharatha || ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā vedanānaṃ yathābhutaṃ ñāṇāya || ||
sn47.4:2.5: Citte cittānupassino viharatha || ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippassannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā cittassa yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāya || ||
sn47.4:2.6: Dammesu dhammānupassino viharatha || ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā dhammānaṃ yathābhutaṃ ñāṇāya || || 5.
sn47.4:3.1: Ye pi te bhikkhave bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemam patthayamānā viharanti || te pi kāye kāyānupassino viharanti || ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā kāyassa pariññāya || ||
sn47.4:3.2: Vedanāsu vedanānupassino viharanti || pe || vedanānam pariññāya || ||
sn47.4:3.4: Dhammesu dhammānupassino viharanti ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā dhammānaṃ pariññāya || || 6.
sn47.4:4.1: Ye pi te bhikkhave bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā || te pi kāye kāyanupassino viharanti || ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā kāyena visaṃyuttā || ||
sn47.4:4.4: Dhammesu dhammānupassino viharanti || ātāpino sampajānā ekodibhūtā vippasannacittā samāhitā ekaggacittā dhammehi visaṃyuttā || || 7.
sn47.4:5.1: Ye pi te bhikkhave bhikkhū navā acirapabbajitā adhunāgatā imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ || te ve bhikkhave bhikkhū imesaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanāya samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā ti || || 1--2.
